scope.worn_tunics: Native animated body retained, with new chest ornaments and collar piping; Star-woven also recolors tunic and cap.

automated_checks: All three portable CTest suites passed normally and with AddressSanitizer/UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer.
Geometry check validated 309,920 nondegenerate triangles across 72 model variants, finite bounded coordinates, unit normals and deterministic appearance selection.
All twelve ordinary equipment bases resolve to a world appearance; invalid and missing bases retain fallback.
Root repository and libultraship git diff --check passed.
native_visual_checks: Inspected enchanted gear and all three ordinary adult preview sets in Hyrule Field: new sword hilts/scabbards, Rootwarden/knight/mirror shields, travel/iron/hover/wind boots, and tunic ornaments.
Ordinary and enchanted swords, shields, tunics and paired boots appeared as physical collectible meshes, upright and slowly turning.
Final build showed settled enchanted child-preview drops fully clear of the ground after increasing per-slot lift.
Adult-to-child and child-to-adult transitions completed; child shield, scabbard, collar ornaments and replacement boots rendered at reduced scale.
Child ordinary preview equipped Kokiri Sword, Deku Shield, Kokiri Tunic and Kokiri Boots; inventory showed zero rolled bonuses.
Remastered equipment toggle off restored native shield, sword hilt, boots and green tunic/cap; enabling it restored the custom set.
Click-to-equip restored the Hylian-based Rootwarden shield while preserving the displaced Deku item; matching preview restored the adult Master Sword set.
Final preview remains open with adult Link wearing the enchanted matching set.
HUD and inventory stayed intact with multiple equipment sets visible after the Metal capacity fix.
Normal player save SHA-256 stayed unchanged.

metal_stress_check.failure_fixed: Unchecked writes beyond the fixed frame vertex allocation caused native texture corruption and stray triangles under detailed gear load.
metal_stress_check.fix: Grow each pooled buffer before upload and invalidate framebuffer bindings; previously encoded draws retain their original Metal resources.
metal_stress_check.result: Multiple ordinary and enchanted sets rendered together without the previously reproduced corruption or allocation errors.

limits: This is an equipment remaster; character, enemy and environment replacements remain outside this pass.
Every combat animation/base combination, broken Giant Knife, native pause equipment model and first-person/reflection exclusions still need broader visual acceptance.
Custom player skeletons and remote Anchor actors are excluded; multiplayer rendering and non-Metal backends were not exercised.
Earlier native combat regression suites were not rerun for this rendering pass. Save format, combat formulas and equipment abilities were not changed.
Mouse drag gesture remains a separate manual acceptance check; this pass used the existing click equip alternative.
